name: [[795,8,27]] three row-space grafts of planar tile code

provenance.construction: Third disjoint four-check row-space graft of codes/796-8-27.json. On its Z side, XOR the surviving images of source codes/798-8-27.json rows [21, 64, 87, 109] to form the stabilizer support [97, 118, 138, 417, 456]. The support in the 796-qubit parent is [97, 118, 138, 415, 454]; use parent pivot row 21, clear parent qubit 415 from other Z checks with this stabilizer, and delete that qubit and its coordinate. The parent already contains two disjoint grafts of codes/798-8-27.json.
provenance.notes: A third local row-space graft lowers n from 796 to 795 while preserving k=8, weight 8, radius 4, and explicit X-27 and Z-27 logicals. The distance is a witness upper bound pending the trusted gate.
